title: Protocol to establish a stable MLL-AF9_AML mouse model
protocol: Seed HEK293T cells in 60 mm culture dishes at a density of 0.5 × 10^6 cells per dish using 5 mL of HEK293T medium.
Culture the cells in a 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator.
Count the cells by adding 20 μL of cell suspension to a 1.5 mL tube and mixing with 20 μL of 0.4% trypan blue solution.
Take out 20 μL of the mixture and add it to a cell counting plate.
Place the cell counting plate into the Countstar Automated Cell Counter for counting.
Change the medium of HEK293T cells with 4 mL of fresh HEK293T medium before transfection.
Prepare two 1.5 mL centrifuge tubes, label them as Tube 1 and Tube 2, then add 250 μL of Opti-MEM to each tube.
Add plasmid and Lipofectamine™ 2000 into the respective tubes according to the protocol.
Mix each tube gently and incubate for 5 min at 24°C.
Combine contents of Tube 2 with those of Tube 1, mix slightly and incubate the mixture for 20 min at 24°C.
Add the transfection mixture into HEK293T cells.
Culture the cells at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator.
Change the medium of transfected HEK293T cells with 4 mL fresh HEK293T medium and 1.0 mM sodium pyruvate early in the morning on day 2.
Euthanize donor mice.
Disinfect the mice with 70% ethanol.
Dissect the tibia and femur of both rear limbs, remove muscles and adipose tissue, and disconnect joints as much as possible.
Place bones into a 60 mm tissue dish containing 4 mL fresh BM washing medium.
Flush bone marrow cells into a new 60 mm tissue dish with 3 mL BM washing medium using a 3 mL syringe with a 25 G 1 1/2 inch needle.
Filter the cell suspension through a 40 μm cell strainer.
Wash the cell strainer with 1 mL BM washing medium.
Centrifuge the filtered cell suspension at 400 g for 8 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellets in 20 mL ACK lysis buffer at 4°C for 8 minutes to remove red blood cells.
Centrifuge again at 400 g for 8 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellets with 5 mL MCs buffer.
Count the cell numbers.
Add 40 μL MCs buffer per 10^7 total cells to resuspend the cell pellets.
Add 10 μL Biotin-Antibody Cocktail per 10^7 cells and mix well.
Incubate at 4°C for 10 minutes.
Add 30 μL MCs buffer and 20 μL Anti-Biotin MicroBeads per 10^7 total cells, mix well.
Incubate at 4°C for 15 minutes.
Add 1 mL MCs buffer per 10^7 total cells to wash the cells.
Centrifuge at 300 g for 10 min.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellets in 500 μL MCs buffer per 5 × 10^7 total cells.
Place the separation column in a MACS separator device.
Rinse the separation column with 500 μL MCs buffer.
Transfer the cell suspension to the separation column and collect the pass-through.
Wash the separation column with 500 μL MCs buffer for three times.
Count the enriched progenitor cells.
Centrifuge cells at 400 g for 8 min and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellets at a density of 1–5 × 10^6 cells/mL with progenitor cell culture medium.
Culture the cells at 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator.
Pre-warm the centrifuge at 30°C.
Collect the retrovirus and filter the virus medium with a 22 μm cell strainer into a 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Add 3.2 mL filtered retrovirus into one well of 6 well plates.
Add 800 μL cell suspension into the virus soup.
Add 4 μg/mL polybrene into the wells.
Centrifuge cells at 550 g, 30°C for 3 h.
Incubate the cells at 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator for 1 h.
Collect BM cells into a 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 400 g for 8 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet with 4 mL progenitor cell culture medium.
Repeat the procedure as on Day 3 to infect BM progenitor cells again.
Add 50 mg/mL G418 into each well of the cell culture plate.
Irradiate C57BL/6 (CD45.2) recipient mice at 960 rads in the morning.
Collect BM cells from a CD45.2 mouse as helper according to the procedure.
Filter the cell suspension with a 40 μm cell strainer into a 50 mL centrifuge tube.
Count the number of cells and take out appropriate cells as BMT donor cells.
Add 1 × 10^6 helper cells per recipient mouse into the collection tube containing donor cells.
Centrifuge the cell mixture at 400 g for 8 minutes.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellets with 1 × PBS.
Centrifuge cells at 400 g for 8 minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Add appropriate amount of 1 × PBS (100 μL per recipient mouse) into the cell pellets.
Pre-warm recipient mice with a warm lamp for about 10-15 minutes to dilate blood vessels.
Use a 1 mL syringe and a 25 G 1 inch needle to mix the cell suspension.
Change the needle to a 27 G 0.5 inch needle.
Inject 100 μL of the cell suspension per mouse through tail veins.
Feed recipient mice with antibiotic-containing water.
Monitor the health condition of irradiated mice and provide auxiliary care if necessary.
Harvest BM cells from primary leukemic recipient mice when they meet the endpoints.
Optional: Harvest blood, liver, and spleen according to experimental purposes.
Prepare 0.1–0.2 × 10^6 BM cells from 1st BMT recipient mice as donor cells for each 2nd recipient mouse in 2nd BMT.
Collect bone marrow cells from primary BMT leukemic mice.
Freeze 5 × 10^6 cells per tube in liquid nitrogen.
Thaw one vial of frozen primary BMT leukemic mouse bone marrow cells the day before secondary transplantation.
Irradiate C57BL/6 (CD45.2) mice at 480 rads in the morning.
Prepare 2nd BMT donor cells according to procedure steps 8b-c and e-h.
Inject donor cells into tail veins of recipient mice.
Monitor engraftment of donor cells in recipient mice.
Collect peripheral blood for measuring CD45.1+ cell percentage via flow cytometry.
Restrict a mouse manually or using a mouse restrainer for blood collection.
Aseptically prepare the tail with 70% ethanol.
Nick the tail with a sterile scalpel blade on a lateral side.
Collect 50 μL of blood in a 0.5 mL MiniCollect tube.
Press the tail to stop bleeding and return the mouse into the cage.
Use 1 mL ACK lysis buffer to lyse red blood cells.
Move the lysis into a new 1.5 mL tube.
Incubate at 4°C for 8 minutes.
Spin down at 400 g for 8 minutes at 4°C and remove the lysis.
Resuspend cell pellets with 1 mL ACK lysis buffer.
Repeat incubation and centrifugation steps.
Use 1 mL ice-cold 1 × PBS to resuspend cell pellets.
Spin down at 400 g for 8 minutes at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Prepare samples according to flow cytometry steps 20b-g.
Fixed flow cytometry samples can be stored in 4°C for 2-3 days before testing.
Collect peripheral blood from the heart into a 0.5 mL MiniCollect tube using a 1 mL syringe with a 27 G 0.5 inch needle.
Test white blood cell count through flow cytometry analysis.
Harvest bone marrow cells and weigh the liver and spleen of leukemia mice.
Optionally, collect liver and spleen tissues for paraffin embedding and H&E staining to investigate leukemic cell infiltration condition.
Observe cell morphology with cytospin specimens of bone marrow cells.
Detect leukemic cell engraftment and differentiation through flow cytometry analysis using bone marrow cells.
Wash 1 × 10^6 leukemia mice bone marrow cells in ice cold 1 × PBS.
Add 30 μL BD staining buffer and 0.3 μL Human TruStain FcXTM to resuspend the cell pellets.
Blend the cells by flicking and incubate at 24°C for 10 minutes.
For leukemic cell engraftment test, add 0.5 μL anti-mouse CD45.1-PE-Cyanine5.5 into TruStain FcXTM blocking cells.
Stain cell samples with anti-mouse CD11b-Super Bright 600 and anti-mouse Gr-1-PE-Cyanine5 antibodies for cell differentiation test.
Keep a blank control without adding any antibodies or simple IgG.
Incubate at 4°C for 25 minutes in the absence of light.
Add 1 mL ice cold 1 × PBS to wash away excess antibodies.
Centrifuge cells at 400 g for 8 minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cell pellets with 400 μL IC Fixation Buffer.
Load resuspended cells for flow cytometry analysis on BD FACSAria III.
Store fixed flow cytometry samples at 4°C for up to 2-3 days before testing.
